Yes!! This is the same as us.
We submitted the documents and heard nothing for 5 months. My boyfriend has been to the office in person but still no progress whatsoever. 

We did everything right. We applied when I was out of the country, my bf was in the country. There's nothing very complicated or unusual about our case.

We're about to pay a lawyer to file a complaint on our behalf.

I'm sorry you're also experiencing this. It's horrible 😞 😢
